You’ll be able to afford styles from heritage brands that cost much more at current retail prices, along with bags in discontinued colors and materials and versions not included in new collections.

## **What Makes a Handbag a Good Investment**


For the best investments, avoid bags representing past trends and look for ones in the signature styles of established houses. Keep in mind that condition and purchase price affect resale results.


Strong demand is a large factor in how well a designer bag holds its value. Fine craftsmanship, recognizable design and relative scarcity increase desirability.

## **What to Check Before Buying a Preowned Bag**


[Louis Vuitton Speedy 35 Bag, 1990s](https://www.1stdibs.com/fashion/handbags-purses-bags/shoulder-bags/louis-vuitton-brown-monogram-canvas-speedy-35-bag/id-v_29784372/)


Before you invest in a designer handbag, following these steps can help ensure it will hold its value:


- Inspect the hardware for scratches, tarnish, or loose fittings.
- Check the corners and base for rubbing.
- Review the stitching for repairs or uneven wear.
- Check for stains or odors inside, as well as peeling on the exterior.
- Confirm that date codes, serial stamps and other identifiers match the brand and period.


And remember: Original boxes, dust bags, receipts and cards can help establish an item’s provenance (history), but they can’t replace professional authentication.[The 1stDibs Promise](https://www.1stdibs.com/about/promise/) covers authenticity, seller standards, accurate item descriptions and buyer support, which gives online shoppers protections that an informal private sale may not provide. Seller quality matters just as much as the bag itself.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### What is the best designer handbag to invest in right now?


Every buyer won’t love every single bag, and no particular bag performs best in every market. Start with the heritage brands and signature designs mentioned above. Then, evaluate the condition, rarity, demand, usability and price.


### Which handbags hold their value the best?


*Vogue’s* 2026 review of resale-market data places Hermès and Chanel among the strongest brands for resale value. But the name on the bag tells you only so much. A particular model may fare better or worse depending on its size, condition, color and relative scarcity.


### Can you actually find an investment-worthy designer bag for under $5,000?


Yes, absolutely. Preowned and vintage examples, as well as smaller sizes and less well-known models from major heritage houses, make the best investments. Louis Vuitton, Fendi, Gucci and Bottega Veneta bags and selected Chanel, Dior and Hermès styles are all possibilities.


### Does a preowned or vintage designer bag hold its value as well as a brand-new one?


It certainly can. A well-kept heritage bag with documentation and in a style that has strong demand can retain its value well, especially if you buy it below current retail. Age alone doesn’t determine performance. Design, rarity, condition and purchase price matter more.


### What should I check before buying a used luxury handbag?


Check any documentation that accompanies the bag, and review its hardware, corners, base, stitching, lining, closures and identifiers. Also, look for any repairs.


### How can I tell if a preowned designer bag is authentic?


You can look for the details you’d expect to find on an authentic bag, but they will take you only so far. When you buy online, the safest approach is to choose a marketplace that vets its sellers, guarantees authenticity and stands behind the items it lists.


---


## **Conclusion**


A designer bag doesn’t have to cost $5,000 or more to be a worthwhile investment. Shopping preowned or vintage gives you more options, especially if you focus on classic designs. Remember to look closely at a bag’s condition, and make sure you’re buying from a seller you can trust.
